reserveReview.rationale: Live Re Metrics as of 2026-08-08 still reports off-chain insurance/reinsurance capital as a single aggregate ($179.6M across the protocol; per-token weights are not published). The six slice names and approximate weights from the live re-metrics adapter are retained, but the off-chain basket is now dispositioned as an untracked exogenous private-credit envelope rather than basket-needs-split because the issuer does not publish a further constituent split.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Re Metrics embedded portfolio snapshot normalized by the live re-metrics adapter. Refreshed 2026-08-09: offchain capital 179,595,196.93 against on-chain rows sUSDe 33,119,662.82, USDC 5,518,045.93, reUSD/sUSDe LP 1,432,132.66, USDT 322,214.02, USDe 229,992.50 and sUSDS 2.01 (total 40,622,049.94), giving an 81.55% off-chain share.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The live source measures off-chain insurance and reinsurance capital in aggregate but does not enumerate trust assets, partner reinsurers, banking counterparties, or internal weights.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The live source measures off-chain capital in aggregate but does not publish a current split by trust asset, reinsurer, bank, or surplus note. It is therefore treated as an exogenous private-credit envelope rather than a splittable stablecoin basket.
The LP is a protocol liquidity position rather than a separate tracked stablecoin reserve claim.
